name: 云听 · 央广在线收音机
description: 云听(radio.cn) 电台直播与节目回听：全国 32 个地区 900+ 个电台、按地区/类型浏览、搜索、正在直播的节目名，以及往期节目回听。

settings.label: Live stream bridge / 直播转流方式
settings.help: auto = Python bridge, then ffmpeg; python = force bridge.py (needs Python 3); ffmpeg = force ffmpeg; direct = hand the HLS URL straight to the player (MyGo Music cannot decode HLS, for debugging only). 默认 auto。

settings.label: Python command / Python 命令名
settings.help: Only a command name, not a path: python3, python or py (these are the declared process permissions). Leave empty to try all three. 只填命令名，不要填绝对路径。

settings.label: ffmpeg command / ffmpeg 命令名
settings.help: Command name on PATH, normally ffmpeg. Only used when the bridge is set to ffmpeg or when Python is unavailable.

settings.label: Live quality / 直播码率
settings.help: high = playUrlMulti / mp3PlayUrlHigh; low = mp3PlayUrlLow / playUrlLow. 填 high 或 low，默认 high。
